title: Whole-chart sections generate principal-open sections
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-weil-pbc-proj-graded-module-chart-basis-comparison-fixed, restrictions of sections of F on the whole fixed affine chart span its sections on each principal open, over the section ring of that open.

source.place: Lemmas 01M4, 01M7; Lemma 01MB, last paragraph; Schemes Lemma 01HV for localized sections

proof.text: Use HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective to write the principal-open parameter as a/f^n. The pointwise formula ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.mk_mem_toSpec_base_apply identifies its preimage in the fixed chart with the preimage of D_+(a). The image under the chart inclusion is D_+(f) intersect D_+(a), hence D_+(f*a). This is a positive-degree homogeneous chart, of degree deg(f)+n*deg(f). No nonzero or nonempty-open assumption is used.

For a section s on D_+(f*a), take a preimage x of alpha(s) under theta. LocalizedModule.induction_on represents x as q/t. The scalar c=1/t satisfies c*mk(q,1)=x by LocalizedModule.mk_smul_mk. The supplied semilinearity, value on mk(q,1), scalar compatibility of alpha, and restriction compatibility of alpha show s=awayToSection(thetaS(c))*restriction(alpha_f.inverse(q)). Thus each section is a single scalar multiple of a restricted whole-chart section.

For an open immersion j, Scheme.Modules.smul_restrictAppIso_inv_apply transports the preceding scalar-multiple description to the restricted module sheaf, sending the scalar through j.appIso. Each generator lies in the span of the restriction range, and closure under scalar multiplication proves span=top. Substitute the geometric image equality and the identity that the image of the whole chart is D_+(f).

proof_origin.note: Complete Lean proof: direct homogeneous-fraction chart presentation, localized fraction as one scalar multiple, and restriction scalar transport. No associated-sheaf comparison or new intermediate theorem is needed.

theorem gradedModuleChart_basisComparison_fixed_generators
    (Z : ∀ f : Fidx, Submodule R[f] N[f])
    (rhoS : ∀ (f g : Fidx), D[g] ≤ D[f] → R[f] →+* R[g])
    (rho : ∀ (f g : Fidx), D[g] ≤ D[f] → Z f →+ Z g)
    (U : ∀ (f g : Fidx), R[f])
    (hU : ∀ (f g : Fidx), (U f g).val = Localization.mk (g.val.1 ^ f.val.2)
      (⟨f.val.1 ^ g.val.2, ⟨g.val.2, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers f.val.1))
    (theta : ∀ (f g : Fidx), D[g] ≤ D[f] →
      LocalizedModule.Away (U f g) (Z f) ≃+ Z g)
    (thetaS : ∀ (f g : Fidx), D[g] ≤ D[f] → Localization.Away (U f g) ≃+* R[g])
    (htheta : ∀ (f g : Fidx) (i : D[g] ≤ D[f]),
      (∀ r : R[f], thetaS f g i (algebraMap R[f] (Localization.Away (U f g)) r) =
        rhoS f g i r) ∧
      (∀ q : Z f, theta f g i (mk q 1) = rho f g i q) ∧
      (∀ (r : Localization.Away (U f g)) (q : LocalizedModule.Away (U f g) (Z f)),
        theta f g i (r • q) = thetaS f g i r • theta f g i q))
    (hcanonical : ∀ (f g : Fidx) (i : D[g] ≤ D[f]),
      ∃ l : Localization.Away f.val.1 →+* Localization.Away g.val.1,
        (∀ a : S, l (algebraMap S (Localization.Away f.val.1) a) =
          algebraMap S (Localization.Away g.val.1) a) ∧
        ∀ r : R[f], (rhoS f g i r).val = l r.val)
    (F : ModX) (alpha : ∀ f : Fidx, F.val.obj (op D[f]) ≃+ Z f)
    (hscalar : ∀ (f : Fidx) (r : R[f]) (s : F.val.obj (op D[f])),
      alpha f ((awayToSection 𝒜 f.val.1 r) • s) = r • alpha f s)
    (hrestriction : ∀ (f g : Fidx) (i : D[g] ≤ D[f])
      (s : F.val.obj (op D[f])),
      alpha g (F.val.map (homOfLE i).op s) = rho f g i (alpha f s))
    (f : Fidx) :
      let e := basicOpenIsoSpec 𝒜 f.val.1 f.property.2 f.property.1
      let E := Scheme.Modules.restrict F D[f].ι
      let B := Set.range (fun r : R[f] ↦ e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r)
      ∀ V : B, Submodule.span (D[f].toScheme.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj (op V.val))
        (Set.range (E.val.map V.val.leTop.op)) = ⊤
